pkgmetadata.longdescription:
Minimal systemd journal reader spawned by pveproxy to serve the node system log view in the pxvirt web UI. Reads the last N lines of the journal (or lines before a cursor) and outputs them for display.
Hard dependency of sys-apps/pve-manager — emerge will refuse to install pve-manager without this package.
Single C source file linking against libsystemd via pkg-config. Installs to /usr/libexec/proxmox-mini-journalreader.
